title: Thee
desc: Brothers Raja and Ravi go down different paths in life and are forced to confront each other.

title: Athiradi Vettai
desc: A policeman sets out to hunt down the men who tried to kill his father.

title: Kannathil Muthamittal
desc: At the age of nine, Amudha learns that she is adopted. Armed with a few facts, she desperately searches for her biological mother in the war-ridden zones of Sri Lanka.

title: Vedan
desc: Vijay, a police officer, strives to capture a criminal. However, when he infiltrates the gang, he strives to keep his identity secret as well as fulfil his mission.

title: Anegan
desc: Madhu, an animator, gets thoughts about her past life, but her psychiatrist believes it to be a figment of her imagination. Later, Madhu meets Ashwin, the man she was in love with in her past life.
